name: CreateBlobContainer
description: Creates a new blob container in the specified storage account. This container is used to store and organize blobs (files such as documents, images, videos, or other binary data) in a structured and scalable manner within cloud storage.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: ContainerName
fields.label: Container Name
fields.description: Creates a new container with the specified name to store and manage related data

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The blob container has been successfully created and is ready to store blobs.
